assumptions: Always-true rules live in plugin files under <skill>/rules/ (top.md, chain.md, steps/<step>.md) that the router reads by fixed path outside the policy merge, so no project override reaches them; a missing skills/10x-pipeline/rules/top.md halts the router
Default rules stay policy keys: prompts.suffix (level 1), new optional prompts.chain-10x / prompts.chain-openspec (level 2), step templates (level 3)

Prompt order: template, advisor, chain defaults, suffix, then the step, chain and top always-true files, with top.md last so the RESULT line still ends the prompt; precedence: always-true wins over everything, and among the defaults the earlier rule wins
Level-3 always-true files are keyed by step name, not by template, so research, research-with-map and research-revise share rules/steps/research.md
@prompts/<f>.md keeps its meaning; a new form @<skill>/prompts/<f>.md (skill matching [a-z0-9-]+) points at another skill folder; an override that names @prompts/os-*.md halts after the move

The OpenSpec steps and prompts move to a skills/openspec-pipeline/policy.json fragment with disjoint keys, deep-merged with the 10x policy before the one project override; the router stays in skills/10x-pipeline/scripts, and only openspec.mjs, the os prompts, the OpenSpec tests and openspec-helpers.mjs move
A new ADR-023 records the hierarchy; ADR-013 Amendment 1 rewords Consequence :141 and records the folder split; ADR-016 and ADR-018 each get a one-line note that their rules now live in rules/top.md
SKILL.md orchestrator rules are only mapped to the levels in ADR-023, not moved, because skill-md-context-diet owns that rewrite; AGENTS.md stays outside the runtime hierarchy
Order: this change runs alone after wave 3 and before wave 4; step-subagent-git-guard runs after it and puts its bans in rules/top.md; the owner updates WAVES.md on main after the merge
